summary: Verified the eBay category auto-creation feature end-to-end. Unit tests for `_ensure_ebay_category` (test_ebay_category_autocreate.py, 7 tests) all pass. Wrote new API-level tests (test_ebay_category_api.py, 5 tests) covering API B (POST /api/products/from-item/{id} auto-creates category + product.category is leaf slug), API C (POST /api/items/bulk with add_to_products creates categories for each item), API D (duplicate imports of same category produce exactly ONE category row), API E (pre-existing categories preserved after auto-create), and R2 (GET /api/products?category=<slug> filters by auto-created slug). Full regression suite: 125 passed, 3 skipped (target was ≥121). Frontend Categories page renders correctly with category-card-<slug> testids and the sidebar link works. NOTE: the endpoint referenced in the review request as `/api/items/{id}/add_to_products` is actually implemented as `/api/products/from-item/{id}` in server.py:1276. Tests use the actual endpoint.

minor.issue: Documented in review request as /api/items/{id}/add_to_products but actual route is /api/products/from-item/{id}. Docs/task drift only — code works correctly.

issues: Pre-existing Recharts warnings about width(-1)/height(-1). Unchanged from iteration_9.

action_items: (Optional) Align endpoint name across docs/tests: either rename route to /api/items/{id}/add_to_products (matches bulk action name) or update the review-request template.
critical_code_review_comments: _ensure_ebay_category correctly handles empty/None/'eBay'-only breadcrumbs, and case-insensitive name lookup prevents slug drift when leaf casing changes.
server.py:1290 order-of-precedence is `ebay_cat_slug or it.get('category') or _guess_category(...)` — good defensive fallback that keeps legacy items functional.

Auto-created rows use `sort_order = count_documents({})` which is racy under concurrent imports (two simultaneous inserts can share the same sort_order). Not observed in tests but worth an atomic $inc counter or a monotonic timestamp.
server.py is still 1910 lines — previously flagged, no change this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Categories page renders, seed cats visible, testids present)

seed_data_creation: All test docs are prefixed TEST_ (items/products) and auto-api- (categories). The autouse fixture wipes them before + after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files cover this feature: test_ebay_category_autocreate.py (helper unit tests) + test_ebay_category_api.py (API-level via requests). The API-level file MUST run serially (-n 0) because parallel autouse cleanup wipes each other's TEST_/auto-api- data — the file already inlines a shared event loop for motor. The real endpoint for single-item import is POST /api/products/from-item/{item_id}; the bulk endpoint is POST /api/items/bulk with action='add_to_products'. Auto-created categories use `_slug(leaf)` for the slug and put `group=<top-of-breadcrumb-after-eBay>` (falls back to 'Imported' for single-crumb).
